name: Legit Check Scanner
blurb: A forensic scanner HUD: B-roll sits in a targeting frame with a scan line sweeping and corner brackets; each line adds a checklist item (STITCHING, TAG, ZIPPER... from the key words) that ticks or crosses; a REAL vs FAKE needle swings and hovers on '?'; on the turn the HUD turns green and the reveal clips get 'MATCH' readouts; title is the verdict screen.
